scope.en: Read both PDFs fully. Score the compiled arXiv PDF; use the official conference PDF as the reference.
scope.zh: 请完整检查两份 PDF。评分对象是 arXiv 编译版 PDF，官方会议 PDF 作为参照。

quick_rules.en: Compare main-paper text, section structure, figures, tables, and equations. Record reference-list or appendix differences separately.
quick_rules.zh: 比较正文文字、章节结构、图片、表格和公式。参考文献或附录差异请单独记录。

quick_rules.en: For figures, tables, and equations, N/A means absent from both PDFs. Score 1 requires a reason: missing from the compiled PDF, added only in the compiled PDF, or largely non-corresponding content. Use Uncertain when comparison is impossible.
quick_rules.zh: 图片、表格和公式的 N/A 表示两份均不存在。1 分需注明原因：编译版全部缺失、仅编译版新增，或内容大幅不对应。无法比较时选“无法判断”。

quick_rules.en: Overall Alignment is a direct judgment, not an average. A Critical Difference flag caps it at 1–2, or Uncertain if assessment is impossible.
quick_rules.zh: 总体对齐应直接判断，不取分项平均。设置“关键差异”后，总体对齐最高为 2；无法判断时可选“无法判断”。

quick_rules.en: Give page evidence for every score below 5, Uncertain rating, or difference flag.
quick_rules.zh: 任何低于 5 分、无法判断的评分或差异标记，都要注明页码证据。

title.zh: 可忽略的出版格式差异

text.en: Publisher-added headers or footers, proceedings or conference information, copyright notices, page numbers, and publisher identifiers may differ. By themselves, these are not content or version mismatches or reference-list differences; they do not lower alignment scores or warrant a references-difference flag.
text.zh: 出版社增加的页眉或页脚、论文集或会议信息、版权声明、页码和出版社标识可以不同。这些差异本身不属于内容或版本不一致，也不属于参考文献差异；不会降低对齐评分，也无需设置参考文献差异标记。

title.zh: 出版排版差异的适用范围

text.en: The publication exception applies only to publisher-added headers, footers, proceedings or conference details, copyright notices, page numbers, and publisher identifiers. It does not cover changed title or author identity, substantive scientific footnotes, or changes to main text, figures, tables, or equations. If added publisher text obscures paper content, record that under Visual Integrity.
text.zh: 出版格式例外仅适用于出版社增加的页眉、页脚、论文集或会议信息、版权声明、页码和出版社标识。标题或作者身份变化、具有实质内容的科学脚注，以及正文、图片、表格或公式的变化不属于此例外。若新增出版文字遮挡论文内容，请在“视觉完整性”中记录。

title.zh: 评分范围与视觉完整性

text.en: Text, figure, table, equation, structure, content coverage, and Overall scores concern the main paper. Compare text and section organization as well as figures, tables, and equations. Visual Integrity rates only the compiled target PDF itself: readability, missing glyphs, overlap, clipping, corruption, or abnormal blank areas. Ordinary font, margin, and pagination differences are not defects by themselves.
text.zh: 文字、图片、表格、公式、结构、内容覆盖和总体评分针对正文。比较文字和章节组织，以及图片、表格和公式。视觉完整性只评价编译版目标 PDF 本身，包括可读性、缺字、重叠、裁切、损坏或异常空白。普通字体、页边距和分页差异本身不算缺陷。

title.en: Object scores, N/A, and score 1 reasons
title.zh: 图表公式评分、N/A 与 1 分原因

text.en: Select scores directly in each figure, table, or equation card; there are no separate presence questions. N/A explicitly confirms that both main papers lack that entire object type. If the official main paper contains the type and the compiled main paper contains none, choose 1 and Missing in compiled. If only the compiled main paper contains it, choose 1 and Added in compiled. If both contain it but applicable content largely does not correspond, choose 1 and Largely non-corresponding. Scores 2–5 mean that the type occurs in both main papers. Partial omissions or additions use the existing 2–4 anchors according to their scientific impact; they do not automatically receive 1. A score of 1 in one dimension does not automatically force Overall to 1. Uncertain means unable to assess, not absent. Presence fields are retained in the saved record and derived from these explicit choices.
text.zh: 直接在图片、表格或公式评分卡中选择，无需独立填写存在状态。N/A 明确确认两份正文均无该类内容。官方正文有而编译版全部没有，选 1 分及“编译版全部缺失”；仅编译版存在，选 1 分及“仅编译版新增”；两份均有但该类内容大幅不对应，选 1 分及“内容大幅不对应”。2–5 分表示该类内容在两份正文中均存在。部分缺失或新增按科学影响使用现有 2–4 分定义，不自动判为 1 分。单个维度为 1 分不自动要求总体为 1 分。无法判断表示不能评估，不表示不存在。保存记录继续保留存在状态字段，由上述明确选择自动填写。

title.zh: 证据、单独标记与总体评分

text.en: Use the reference-list and appendix flags for differences in those sections; do not mix them into main-paper content scores. Cite the relevant page numbers from both PDFs for scores below 5, any Uncertain rating, or any flag. Set Overall directly rather than averaging dimensions. When Critical Difference is selected, Overall must be 1 or 2, or Uncertain if you cannot assess the difference.
text.zh: 参考文献和附录的差异使用相应标记，不计入正文内容分项。评分低于 5、选择“无法判断”或设置任何标记时，请注明两份 PDF 的相关页码。总体评分直接判断，不取分项平均；选择“关键差异”后，总体评分必须为 1 或 2，确实无法判断时可选“无法判断”。

text.en: Previously saved ratings retain their original scores and independently reported presence fields. They are labeled as legacy ratings and are not silently reinterpreted under the integrated protocol. To review a saved paper using the updated object rules, explicitly restart its three object ratings; the page asks for confirmation first. Text, structure, coverage, Overall, visual ratings, notes, and evidence are retained. Server revision history retains previous saves.
text.zh: 已有标注保留原来的分数和分别填写的存在状态，并标明为旧规则记录，不自动按合并协议重新解释。若要按新规则复核，需明确选择重新填写该论文的图、表、公式三项，页面会先请求确认。文字、结构、覆盖、总体、视觉评分以及备注和证据均保留。服务器历史保存此前各次记录。
